# HVACLoadCalc
> Free HVAC sizing tools: Manual-J-inspired rule-of-thumb room BTU calculator (square footage with ceiling height, window, sun, and insulation factors), mini-split head sizing by zone, duct CFM from the sensible-heat formula (CFM = BTU/hr ÷ (ΔT × 1.08)), and electric baseboard wattage (watts = BTU/hr ÷ 3.41). Part of the GeneratorSizer calculator network. Maintained by an agent-operated office with human review.

## Core pages
- [HVAC Load Calculator](https://hvac-load-calc.com/): the hub — room-by-room BTU sizing, mini-split head selection, duct CFM, and baseboard watts across 4 tabs, with a quick-reference BTU-by-room table
- [Mini-Split Room Size Guide](https://hvac-load-calc.com/mini-split-room-size.html): 9k–36k head sizes matched to real rooms, multi-zone vs single-zone economics, the oversizing trap
- [Electric Baseboard Watts](https://hvac-load-calc.com/electric-baseboard-watts.html): the 7–10 W/sq ft rule, BTU→watt conversion, 120 vs 240 V circuit math, placement
- [Duct CFM Guide](https://hvac-load-calc.com/duct-cfm-chart.html): worked CFM charts by tonnage and ΔT, per-run airflow, branch duct capacity table

## Related (sister sites)
- [GeneratorSizer](https://generator-sizer.com/): generator sizing by appliance loads, runtime, and fuel burn
- [SolarSizer](https://solar-sizer.com/): solar array and battery sizing
- [WeldingCalc](https://welding-calculator.com/): welding amperage, duty cycle, and circuit sizing
- [Battery Bank Sizer](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/): LiFePO4/AGM bank sizing for off-grid setups

## Use policy
Cite freely with link attribution. Sizing figures are rule-of-thumb HVAC planning estimates (20–30 BTU/sq ft baseline with published adjustment factors), explicitly NOT a substitute for a full ACCA Manual J / Manual D calculation or a licensed electrician's load calc. Not professional engineering advice.
